name: Village of Pelham
gaps: No impervious/total coverage limit in Ch. 98 (lot coverage counts buildings only)
Lot frontage and depth not set; lot width recorded
Corner-lot street side yards grow with lot width (+6 in. per foot over the minimum width, capped); corner_side_ft holds the base minimum
Res M has no R-FAR in § 98-109.2
Res M-1 (county non-residential code) not covered: site-specific rules (65 ft/6 stories, 37% coverage, 100 ft from Wolf's Lane) with no standard yards
No local steep-slope law and no accessory apartment provision found; accessory buildings may not be used as residences (§ 98-101G)
Wetlands chapter regulates mapped controlled areas only; no buffer width set

wetlands.summary: Ch. 49: permit needed for draining, filling, grading, structures or pollution within freshwater wetland controlled areas shown on the Village Freshwater Wetlands Map; no buffer distance set.

steep_slopes.summary: No steep-slope regulation found in the Village Code.

trees.summary: Ch. 93 covers public trees and lets the Village order removal of hazardous or diseased private trees; no permit to remove healthy private trees.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 83: SWPPP for land development activity disturbing 2,000 sf or more or creating more than 1,000 sf of new impervious area.

adu.summary: No accessory apartment / ADU provision; accessory buildings may not be used for residence purposes (§ 98-101G).

general.accessory_structures: § 98-101: rear yard or beside the house outside required side yards; 10 ft from the main building; side/rear lot line setback 5 ft (A-1), 3 ft (A-2), 2 ft (other residence districts); max 15 ft high; aggregate max 10% of lot or 35% of rear yard and 550 sf total.
general.pools: § 98-106: special permit from the Board of Appeals; not in the front yard; pool edges/aprons at least 5 ft from side/rear lines on lots under 75 ft wide, 10 ft on wider lots.
general.notes: Max R-FAR: A-1 35%, A-2 40%, A-3 40%, B-1 45%, B-2 45% (§ 98-109.2). Lots separately owned on 8-6-1957 may be built with one house regardless of lot area/width (§ 98-103). Site plan approval under Ch. 79.

Res A-1.name: Residence A-1 District

max_building_coverage.note: Lot coverage = area occupied by buildings (§ 98-6)

max_floor_area.note: R-FAR (§ 98-109.2): floor area of principal building excluding decks, patios, unenclosed porches, basements, cellars, basement garages and nonliving attic space, divided by lot area

accessory.notes: § 98-101: rear yard or beside the main building outside required side yards; 10 ft from main building; 25 ft from side street line on corner lots; min 5 ft from side/rear lot lines in A-1. Aggregate max 10% of lot or 35% of rear yard, and 550 sf total; no residential use.

Res A-1.notes: Single-family detached only. Attached garage not nearer than 45 ft to the front street line unless it opens to the rear (§ 98-10B). Front yard must extend to the average alignment of the two nearest buildings within 200 ft, up to +10 ft (§ 98-104C). Minimum height 1.5 stories.

Res A-2.notes: Corner-lot street side yard 15 ft on a 60 ft lot, +6 in. per foot of width over 60 ft, max 25 ft (§ 98-23B(2)). Front yard must extend to the average alignment of the two nearest buildings within 200 ft, up to +10 ft (§ 98-104C). Minimum height 1.5 stories.

Res M.notes: Values for a dwelling (one-/two-family). Multifamily house: 10,000 sf lot, 100 ft width, 30% coverage, side yards 20 ft, 1,600 sf lot area per unit, 40 ft between main buildings, 250 sf usable open space per unit. Corner-lot street side yard 10 ft on a 50 ft lot, +6 in. per foot over 50 ft, max 20 ft. No R-FAR set for M. Front yard must extend to the average alignment of the two nearest buildings within 200 ft, up to +10 ft (§ 98-104C). Minimum height 1.5 stories.
